metaDescription: Discover BMYGYM Retreats in Valencia: an intimate Mediterranean setting for time devoted to yourself. Enquire about current programmes, prices and reservations.
title: BMYGYM Retreats
heroText: An intimate, feminine retreat by the Mediterranean. A slower rhythm, thoughtful details and space to reconnect with yourself.
valenciaText: Warm light, the sea close by and a little distance from the everyday. Valencia is the setting for a more personal BMYGYM experience, where time for yourself takes centre stage.
experienceText: An intimate retreat for a limited number of women, combining individual guidance, mindful movement, personalised fitness and nutrition, and moments of Mediterranean stillness.
experienceGuidance: Thoughtfully curated in Valencia. Personally guided by the founder of BMYGYM.
programmesText: Contact us for current programmes, prices and available dates. We will share the details of each experience with you personally.
programmesNote: Programme, price and availability are agreed directly with BMYGYM before your reservation is confirmed.
yachtText: BMYGYM Retreats will extend beyond the shore with a new collection of intimate experiences at sea.
yachtDescription: A more private expression of movement, wellbeing and Mediterranean living.
reservationText: Tell us what you are looking for and your preferred dates. Use the form or write to us for current programmes, prices and reservation details.
